faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education Recruitment 2026 is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Business Development Head – Executive Education post in the IIMU Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Business Development Head – Executive Education posts at IIMU is Online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Business Development Head – Executive Education at IIMU?
faq.answer: The salary for the Business Development Head – Executive Education post at IIMU is Rs. 25 LPA Per Annum, starting from ₹25 LPA onwards.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for Business Development Head – Executive Education?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree, preferably in Business Administration or equivalent in any discipline from a recognized university, with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education Recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Business Development Head – Executive Education post includes shortlisting, followed by a Written Test / Skill Test / Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for IIMU Business Development Head – Executive Education Recruitment can be found on the official website of IIMU. A direct link is also provided in the Important Links section.

faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Management Udaipur (IIMU) is https://www.iimu.ac.in. You can find all recruitment-related information there.
